VERIFICATION FAILED for PAN-4618 (attempt 1/3):

Failed check: sync-target-branch

Sync with main FAILED — merge conflicts detected:

Merge conflicts with main:
  - .overdeck/context/codebase/concerns.md

## REQUIRED: Resolve merge conflicts BEFORE resubmitting

1. Run: `git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main`
2. Resolve all conflicts in the listed files
3. Run the project's build and tests to verify nothing broke
4. Commit and push ALL changes

After fixing:
1. Run the project's build and tests
2. Commit and push ALL changes
3. ONLY THEN resubmit: pan review request PAN-4618 -m "Fixed sync-target-branch"

Do NOT resubmit until all repos sync cleanly and tests pass.

VERIFICATION FAILED for PAN-4618 (attempt 1/3):

Failed check: vbrief-ac

Acceptance criteria check FAILED — 34/34 AC incomplete:

### Add paths-ignore for .pan/** and .overdeck/memory/** to CI's push trigger (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given ci.yml is parsed as YAML, on.push['paths-ignore'] returns exactly ['.pan/**', '.overdeck/memory/**'] and on.pull_request has no paths or paths-ignore key
  - [ ] git diff origin/main -- .github/workflows/no-planning-on-main.yml produces no output

### Add a cancel-in-progress concurrency group to ci.yml (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given ci.yml is parsed as YAML, concurrency.group returns 'ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}' and concurrency['cancel-in-progress'] returns true
  - [ ] Given two pushes to feature/pan-4618 less than a run apart, gh run list --branch feature/pan-4618 --workflow CI shows the first push's CI run with conclusion cancelled and the second push's run not cancelled
  - [ ] The concurrency block sits at workflow level (a top-level key), so it applies to both push and pull_request runs, and on.push/on.pull_request keys are otherwise unchanged by this item

### Default-branch test verdict skips commits without a decisive test run (100-commit window) (5/5 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given 20 newest commits carrying only reject-planning-paths above a commit whose 'test' check failed, readDefaultBranchFailingTestChecks returns a set containing 'test'
  - [ ] Given 12 commits whose test checks concluded cancelled above a commit whose 'test' check failed, it returns a set containing 'test'
  - [ ] Given 12 commits whose test checks are in progress, it returns null and sends no check-runs request for the 11th and 12th commits
  - [ ] Given a full 100-commit page with no test checks it returns null, given a 3-commit page with none it returns an empty set, and its commit-list request contains per_page=100
  - [ ] defaultBranchCommitTestVerdict returns 'indecisive' for a single completed 'test' check with conclusion cancelled

### DoD row 6 later-green fallback counts only candidates that carry a CI run (5/5 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given candidates bk1..bk6 carrying only reject-planning-paths followed by a candidate with every required check successful, checkMainVerifyRow returns pass citing that candidate
  - [ ] Given 6 CI-bearing candidates whose 'test' failed followed by a green one, checkMainVerifyRow returns miss and readCheckRuns is not called for the 7th candidate
  - [ ] Given a promote merge followed by a .pan/backlog/sequence.md commit in a real git repo, readContainingDefaultBranchCommits returns a list that contains the promote commit
  - [ ] Given candidates [bkTip with every required check green, codeC with no checks], checkMainVerifyRow returns pass citing bkTip
  - [ ] When the edit is done, wc -l src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts prints 1000 or fewer lines and git diff origin/main -- scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt prints nothing

### Add resolveCiHead to src/lib/ci/project-ci-github.ts (4/4 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given the workflow-runs call returns a run on C, resolveCiHead returns C after exactly one request to repos/o/r/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?branch=main&event=push&per_page=1
  - [ ] Given the newest CI run is on B, the bookkeeping tip of a mixed push, resolveCiHead returns B
  - [ ] Given the workflow-runs call rejects with 'gh: Not Found (HTTP 404)' or returns no runs, resolveCiHead falls back to the branches/main sha
  - [ ] Given the workflow-runs call rejects with a non-404 error, resolveCiHead rejects with that error; given the fallback branches call returns no sha, it returns null

### Project CI REST fill projects the CI head (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given the branch head is a bookkeeping commit and the newest CI run is on sha-code, fillProjectCiObservation returns headSha 'sha-code' with sha-code's suites
  - [ ] Given a code-commit head with runs from two workflows, the observation's headSha equals the CI head and suites has two entries
  - [ ] packages/contracts/src/events.ts and src/lib/ci/project-ci-observation.ts contain 'CI head' in the comments of project.ci_suite_observed, project.ci_head_observed and observationFromCheckSuite, and git diff shows no non-comment change in those two files

### check_suite webhook records default-branch suites against the CI head (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given resolveCiHead returns 'code-sha', a github-actions check_suite for head_sha 'code-sha' on main appends one project.ci_suite_observed event with headSha 'code-sha'
  - [ ] Given resolveCiHead returns 'code-sha', a check_suite for head_sha 'bk-sha' appends no project.ci_suite_observed event

### Regression test: pan reload builds origin/main when HEAD is a bookkeeping commit (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given origin/main HEAD is a commit touching only .pan/backlog/sequence.md, buildDashboardFromOriginMain returns builtSha equal to that commit's sha
  - [ ] The deployment worktree contains src/app.ts from the parent code commit and installAndBuild is called with the deployment root
  - [ ] git diff origin/main -- src/lib/deploy/build-from-origin.ts produces no output

### Flywheel, recap and consolidation skills state the newest-decisive-run rule for main's CI (4/4 incomplete)
  - [ ] pan-flywheel/SKILL.md contains the red-main rule sentence with select(.conclusion == "success" or .conclusion == "failure") and 'PAN-4618', and roles/flywheel.md contains the same sentence
  - [ ] pan-flywheel/SKILL.md (under the line 206 deploy step) contains the deploy rule requiring status completed and conclusion success on gh run list --branch main --workflow CI --limit 1, and roles/flywheel.md contains the same rule after its Deploys bullet
  - [ ] pan-recap/SKILL.md's main CI command contains --limit 20 and select(.conclusion == "success" or .conclusion == "failure"), and pan-consolidate-conversations/SKILL.md contains 'newest decisive CI run'
  - [ ] The commit that changes roles/flywheel.md has a line matching ^Prompt-Change: in its message, and npm run lint:skills exits 0

### Document bookkeeping commits skipping CI in PIPELINE-GATES, MERGE-WORKFLOW and EXTERNAL-EVENT-STREAM (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md contains the heading 'Bookkeeping commits skip CI and superseded runs are cancelled (PAN-4618)' and a section naming .pan/**, .overdeck/memory/**, cancel-in-progress, resolveCiHead, the 100-commit test-verdict window and DoD row 6's skip of candidates missing a required check
  - [ ] docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md contains a paragraph stating that pan reload builds origin/main HEAD whatever its CI state and that a bookkeeping HEAD has no CI run (PAN-4618)
  - [ ] docs/EXTERNAL-EVENT-STREAM.md contains the text 'newest push run of the CI workflow' in both the project.ci_suite_observed row and the project.ci_head_observed row

## REQUIRED: Complete all acceptance criteria BEFORE resubmitting

1. Review the incomplete AC above
2. Implement the missing requirements and write tests
3. Close every completed task with `pan task close` — the canonical writer publishes the close and AC statuses sync automatically; never hand-edit spec files
4. Commit and push ALL changes
5. ONLY THEN resubmit: pan review request PAN-4618 -m "Completed acceptance criteria"

Do NOT resubmit until all AC are completed.
